results.controlIntent: Require the developer of the system, system component, or system service, at all post-design stages of the system development life cycle, to: a. Develop and implement a plan for ongoing security and privacy control assessments; b. Perform [Selection (one or more): unit; integration; system; regression] testing/evaluation [Assignment: organization-defined frequency] at [Assignment: organization-defined depth and coverage]; c. Produce evidence of the execution of the assessment plan and the results of the testing and evaluation; d. Implement a verifiable flaw remediation process; and e. Correct flaws identified during testing and evaluation.

judgment.rationale:
Control SA-11.v0 requires an ongoing assessment plan with substantive, functioning testing/evaluation, evidence of execution, and a flaw remediation process. The evidence retrieved reveals multiple critical deficiencies:

1. **Assessment plan is not substantive / not functioning (SA-11.b, SA-11.c):** Only a single DataQuality monitoring schedule exists for the endpoint. Its last run *failed* with the reason "No capture data found — data capture is disabled." This means the monitoring infrastructure is broken at the source — data capture is not enabled on the endpoint, so no inference traffic is being captured for evaluation. The schedule is effectively inoperative.

2. **Incomplete coverage (SA-11.a, SA-11.b):** No ModelQuality, ModelBias, or ModelExplainability schedules were found. A sufficiency-focused control requires that the assessment configuration be substantively adequate. A single, non-functional DataQuality schedule does not constitute adequate depth and coverage of ongoing security and privacy control assessments for a production ML model.

3. **No evidence of execution or results (SA-11.c):** Because the only schedule is failing, there is no evidence of successful test/evaluation runs or produced results that could demonstrate the assessment plan is being executed.

4. **Flaw remediation not demonstrated (SA-11.d, SA-11.e):** The known flaw — data capture being disabled — has not been corrected. The failure has persisted (last run: 2026-06-02), indicating no verifiable flaw remediation process is in place or being applied.

In aggregate, the monitoring configuration is neither substantive nor operational, failing the sufficiency standard required by SA-11.v0.
gaps: Data capture configuration for the endpoint (enabled/disabled status, capture percentage) — needed to confirm root cause and whether it has since been remediated
ModelQuality, ModelBias, and ModelExplainability monitoring schedules — absence confirmed by tool response but no detail on why they were never created
Baseline datasets and baseline creation records — not returned, so it is unclear whether baselines exist for any monitor type
Historical run results / assessment reports — needed to evaluate SA-11.c (evidence of execution and results)
Flaw/defect tracking records or remediation tickets — needed to evaluate SA-11.d and SA-11.e (verifiable flaw remediation process)
Unit, integration, system, or regression test records from the model development lifecycle — not available via the collector tools used; human attestation required
